commands.purpose: Compile a provider-neutral repository portfolio snapshot into comparable baseline punch cards.
Request a current provider/account/repository denominator without making provider or repository mutations.
Request integration, product/project, domain/sub-domain, hosting and API applicability classification for a baseline subject.
Request current source, current-pack, state-packet, evidence and continuation hydration by reference.
Request worker/provider capability, security, proof and execution-surface qualification without granting authority.
Request accepted default-branch/main generation and exact current provider readback.
Request branch/PR donor, active, merged, superseded, hold and unknown classification; destructive cleanup is not implied.
Request SDK primitive/command/adoption currentness and affected-only delta for a consumer.
Request deterministic receipt-bound repo/org score projection; UNKNOWN and unproven cells receive no closure credit.
Request an affected-only burn/formation plan from current punch-card holes; planning is not dispatch authority.
Request ingestion/reconciliation of Result, RETURN and APPLY_RETURN receipts against the frozen baseline generation.
Request promotion of a qualified accepted result to the next frozen baseline and invalidation of stale consumers.
Compile project/product/capability-family baselines separately from repository inventory, including IA, brand/persona, API, simulation, ACK and return readiness.
Compile MICRO/MESO/MACRO/META closure independently across the six runtime-main stages; no layer inherits green from another.
Compile one bounded distributed ACK packet per repository from a baseline without performing provider delivery.
Validate one provider-neutral distributed ACK/Attempt/Result/RETURN envelope without trusting provider identity as authority.
Compile an organization burn-map projection from baseline punch cards and current return receipts.
Compile a discovery through the reusable-learning ladder: generalized invariant, SDK materialization, Bins ledger record, distributed ACK, adopter proof and return rejoin.
List exact existing public callable exports and positional JSON argument counts.
Compute one existing public SDK export from bounded JSON stdin without provider effects.
